label: S. 5635
title: Arts Education for All Act

items.snippet: This bill expands arts education and programming for children in early education, K-12 students, and juveniles and adults in the criminal justice system.
This bill expands arts education and programming for children in early education, K-12 students, and juveniles and adults in the criminal justice system.
Additionally, the bill addresses arts programming in elementary and secondary schools by directing each state educational agency to include information on arts programming in its state plan,…
The bill directs the National Center for Education Research to carry out research on the use of arts and arts education in elementary and secondary schools, including in low-performing schools.
Further, the National Center for Education Statistics must compile data on arts education.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

L000570.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
L000570.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
L000570.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
